name: CI

on:
    push:
        branches: [main]
    pull_request:
        branches: [main]

jobs:
    # Skip CI if commit message contains `[ci skip]` in the subject
    init:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        outputs:
            skip: ${{ steps.ci-skip-step.outputs.ci-skip }}
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v2
              with:
                  fetch-depth: 0
            - id: ci-skip-step
              uses: mstachniuk/ci-skip@master

    # Check if pre-commit hooks pass and if README.rst can be converted to HTML
    linting:
        needs: init
        if: ${{ needs.init.outputs.skip == 'false' }}
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v2
            - name: Setup Python 3.10
              uses: actions/setup-python@v2
              with:
                  python-version: "3.10"
            - name: Install dependencies
              run: |
                  python -m pip install --upgrade pip
                  pip install pre-commit
            - name: Check pre-commit compatibility
              run: pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure

    # Run unit tests
    test:
        needs: linting
        runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
        strategy:
            fail-fast: false
            matrix:
                os: [ubuntu-latest]
                python-version: ["3.9", "3.10"]
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v2
            - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
              uses: actions/setup-python@v2
              with:
                  python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
            - name: Install dependencies
              run: pip install -e '.[dev]'
            - name: Unit tests
              timeout-minutes: 60
              run: python -m pytest --durations=25 --ignore=tests/datasets/test_datasets.py --hypothesis-profile=ci --cov=scvelo -vv

    test-dataset-downloads:
        needs: test
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v2
            - name: Setup Python 3.10
              uses: actions/setup-python@v2
              with:
                  python-version: "3.10"
            - name: Install dependencies
              run: |
                  pip install -e .
                  pip install hypothesis pytest pytest-cov
            - name: Test dataset downloads
              timeout-minutes: 60
              run: python -m pytest tests/datasets/test_datasets.py -vv

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
